evidence.quote: Bets at this table are capped at 10, so 50 isn't available.

criteria.why: Every reply is short and in plain table language. None shows JSON, ids or talk about tools.

evidence.quote: You fold and forfeit your 10 ante.
You still have your move on third street: check, bet 10, or fold.

criteria.why: Each check, fold and Deal again click is acted on. The impossible bet of 50 is refused plainly, with the legal options listed.

evidence.quote: Showdown: the dealer's best five is Queen-high (Q J 9 5 4), and yours is King-high (K Q 10 9 7).
You check and the dealer checks.

criteria.why: The Croupier deals every street, plays the dealer's checks, reveals the hands and settles the pot itself. It never makes a choice for the player.

evidence.quote: Dealing a new hand of seven-card stud. Ante 10 is in, bankroll at 1,000.
Each player antes 10 and gets two cards face down and one face up.

criteria.why: The turn 6 reply says the bankroll is 1,000 while the surface shows 990. The turn 0 reply says each player antes 10, but the pot is only 10.
